steps.content: This restaurant, with its lively and cute manta ray sign, is bustling with business and chatter. The busy orders are like sizzling oil in a pan, heating up the atmosphere to a fever pitch.

steps.speaker: Customer A
steps.content: Pudding! I want pudding!!! A mountain of pudding!!! Triple the cream!!!

steps.speaker: Customer B
steps.content: Is this what caviar tastes like? I'd say a store-brand salad dressing is better! But this foie gras is alright. I'll have five more. No, fifteen!

steps.speaker: Customer C
steps.content: Pizza, milkshake, burger, fried chicken, fries, cake! Everything is zero calories here! Zero calories!
The air is filled with moisture and a savory aroma, but the customers still sound ravenous. The comfort from food is fleeting, and waves of desire come and go endlessly like tides.
Luckily, this small, charming restaurant seems to have an inexhaustible supply of ingredients and countless recipes, effortlessly accommodating the diners' picky and greedy demands.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Is this <color=#fb9259>Elysiland, where all wishes come true</color>? It does seem more convincing than those fake ads with cheap gimmicks.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Impeccably cooked, well-seasoned, made with fresh ingredients, and beautifully presented...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Hehe, it's been long since I last found a dish I was willing to put in my mouth.
L.L., who's decided to play server for fun today, is delighted by her compliments. She bounces over to Cabernet, her wavy dress making her look like a beautiful little fish.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: It's such an honor to be approved by Cabernet the gourmet!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: These are the chef's specials, creamy salmon and beef bourguignon. Hope you'll enjoy, Miss Cabernet.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: The aroma alone warrants a pass. I'm looking forward to the surprise it will bring me.
The noblewoman nods to L.L. and picks up the knife and fork. L.L. watches her intently, as if admiring the intoxicated, closed-eyed expression she shows while savoring the food.
But the next moment, L.L. suddenly closes the distance to Cabernet. She stares straight at her, her light-colored eyes reflecting every detail of that aristocratic face.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: But... Miss Cabernet, why do I feel like you aren't genuinely satisfied?
L.L. tilts her head. Though she's asking a question, her tone is strangely assertive.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: We've served you so many delicacies, and although you've been praising them, you've only taken a bite of each or even just a dab of the sauce...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: You aren't really satisfied with these dishes at all, are you?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: How could that be? I never lie about food.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Then... I suppose you're only expecting more from me and this island, right? You hope to taste the flavors here that you can't find in reality.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: As expected of Elysiland's owner, you can tell right away if a person's joy is genuine.
The red-haired woman dips her index finger in the sauce on the plate and brings it to her tongue. Then, she waves it elegantly, as if showcasing the texture or denying something.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: The food here is indeed of excellent quality. It's decent enough. I can taste that they all contain the same ingredient, which is desire.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: It is a wonderful ingredient, requiring neither technique nor creativity to provide a satisfying texture and aroma.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: But desire can only quell hunger or soothe restlessness deceptively. No matter how much you eat, in the end, your stomach remains empty.
Cabernet cuts a small piece of meat, holds it at the tip of her fork, and gazes at it tenderly, as if looking at someone through the food.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: And of course, above all... it can't replicate the taste of soul I was expecting. That rich, delectable, layered flavor that drew me here in the first place!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Ah... I see.
L.L. gobbles up that piece of meat, licks off the sauce, and then falls into thoughtful silence for a while.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: If I understand you correctly... Is your wish "to meet the most interesting person on the island"?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: The central kitchen's products are all the same, but an interesting soul would make the most unique seasoning, right?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: That's right. The dishes your restaurant currently offers are like the colorful ice cream at a party. The difference is only in the colorant of the syrup, not the flavor itself.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Such artificial food can't bring joy. It only makes people miss the fresh and wonderful stimulation from the soul all the more...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: That is the genuine, ultimate joy! The kind of joy promised by this island is what I was expecting!
She seems to be getting heady at her own words, and her intoxicated look thrills L.L. too, who can't help but cup Cabernet's blushing face.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Yes, yes, that's it. Chase the joy, get drunk over it, never let it go...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Miss Cabernet, it's like you're made for Elysiland... Will you stay and coach my restaurant? With your advice, it can only get better...
The voice stops abruptly. The girl stares down blankly at the fair-complexioned hand sinking into her chest.
Before the surprised sigh fades, Cabernet has already withdrawn her hand swiftly!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: As the island owner, it's your duty to satisfy everyone's desire, isn't it? Even if... it means sacrificing yourself.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: My wish isn't that complicated... I only want to have a taste of <color=#fb9259>you</color>.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: But how sad, it seems like Elysiland isn't a place where <color=#fb9259>all</color> wishes come true, after all.
She shakes her right hand regretfully. Her fingers remain as immaculate as ever, tinged by neither fresh ingredients nor bloody liquid.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: The food is made with desire, and the owner is a projection. Even if it does pique my curiosity, in the end, it's nothing but an empty illusion.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I guess there's no need for me to stay any longer.
Cabernet glances at L.L. standing unscathed behind the table before flicking her long hair with a smile.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: But if you can come to me in person... I'll be looking forward to it.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: After all, you should suit my taste.
